tier1.notes: Fixes a phone-hotspot connection that worked and was then dropped about a minute later -- most often on the second attempt after switching the receiver on. Adds a WiFi network picker: the receiver scans for networks and offers the list to the app, including your own phone's hotspot, which a phone cannot show you itself. Installs from the app in a few seconds; no card removal.

tier2.notes: Reflash required only if your receiver is older than 0.24.40 -- newer units can take this over the air from the app. Download the .img.xz to a computer and write it to the microSD card with BalenaEtcher -- not Raspberry Pi Imager, whose WiFi/hostname presets conflict with the receiver. Do not decompress the file first.
